# coolify_gitlab_apps (Data Source)

Lists Coolify GitLab Apps. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_gitlab_apps" "all" {}

output "gitlab_app_names" {
  value = [for a in data.coolify_gitlab_apps.all.apps : a.name]
}
```
